mapper.sql: SELECT b.bill_id,b.bill_stg_id,false AS virtual_plan,b.bill_no,b.prj_id, p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt,b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt, b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt,b.rcpt_plan_dt, COALESCE(r.received_amt,0)::bigint AS received_amt, (b.tot_amt::numeric+COALESCE(a.adjustment,0))::bigint AS adjusted_total_amt, CASE WHEN b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND b.amnd_yn='N' THEN greatest(0,b.tot_amt::numeric+COALESCE(a.adjustment,0)-COALESCE(r.received_amt,0)) ELSE 0 END::bigint AS receivable_amt, NULL::integer AS reminder_stage,b.bill_odr_no,b.amnd_yn,b.rmrk_desc, COALESCE(b.bill_dt,s.bill_plan_dt) AS sort_date, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN extract(year FROM COALESCE(b.bill_dt,s.bill_plan_dt))::int ELSE substring(b.atrb_ym,1,4)::int END AS row_year FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN prj.bill_stg s ON s.bill_stg_id=b.bill_stg_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.bill_id,sum(r.rcpt_amt) AS received_amt FROM bill.rcpt r GROUP BY r.bill_id) r ON r.bill_id=b.bill_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.orgnl_bill_id,sum(a.tot_amt) AS adjustment FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.amnd_yn='Y' AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' GROUP BY a.orgnl_bill_id) a ON a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id

UNION ALL SELECT NULL::bigint,s.bill_stg_id,true,NULL::varchar,s.prj_id,p.prj_nm,p.cust_ptnr_id,c.ptnr_nm, p.cntrct_ty_cd,NULL::char(7),NULL::date,s.sply_amt,0::bigint,s.sply_amt,'PLAN', NULL::varchar,NULL::date,NULL::date,0::bigint,s.sply_amt,0::bigint,NULL::integer, s.stg_odr_no,'N',NULL::varchar,s.bill_plan_dt,extract(year FROM s.bill_plan_dt)::int FROM prj.bill_stg s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id AND b.amnd_yn='N' AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL')
mapper.select: SELECT x.* FROM () x WHERE x.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT x.* FROM () x JOIN bill.bill a ON a.bill_id=x.bill_id WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY x.bill_id
SELECT FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN prj.bill_stg s ON s.bill_stg_id=b.bill_stg_id WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF b
SELECT p.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.stlm_mthd_cd,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.bill_stg_id,s.prj_id,s.stg_odr_no,s.sply_amt,s.bill_plan_dt FROM prj.bill_stg s WHERE s.prj_id=#{projectId} AND s.bill_stg_id=#{stageId}
SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id='VAT_RATE' AND aply_bgn_ym <=#{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(max(substring(bill_no FROM 8)::bigint),0) FROM bill.bill WHERE bill_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%' AND substring(bill_no FROM 8) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
SELECT b.bill_id FROM bill.bill b WHERE AND b.bill_stts_cd IN ('DRAFT','CONFIRM','PLAN') ORDER BY b.bill_id LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(max(b.bill_odr_no),0) FROM bill.bill b WHERE

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,COALESCE(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id, d.dev_nm AS display_name,a.asgn_se_cd,#{month}::text AS work_ym,m.mm_qty, u.bill_untprc_amt AS untprc_amt,t.atnd_id,t.work_day_qty,t.rglr_tm_qty AS work_tm_qty, t.ovtm_tm_qty,t.mth_work_day_qty FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=COALESCE(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <=greatest(#{first}::date,a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <=#{last} AND a.end_dt >=#{first} ORDER BY a.asgn_id

SELECT l.asgn_id,a.dev_id,l.cntrct_dev_id,d.dev_nm AS display_name,l.work_ym,l.mm_qty, m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,l.untprc_amt,l.work_day_qty,l.work_tm_qty,l.ovtm_tm_qty, l.ovtm_amt,l.bill_amt,l.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl l LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=l.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=l.cntrct_dev_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=l.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=l.work_ym WHERE l.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY l.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_id

SELECT concat(h.data_chg_ty_cd,' ',h.clmn_nm,' ',h.bfr_val,' → ',h.aft_val) AS description, h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE (h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=#{id}::text) OR (h.tbl_nm='bill.rcpt' AND h.rsn_desc='bill_id=' || #{id}::text) ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.bill SET bill_dt=#{state.bill_dt},sply_amt=#{state.sply_amt},vat_amt=#{state.vat_amt}, txinv_no=#{state.txinv_no},txinv_dt=#{state.txinv_dt},rcpt_plan_dt=#{state.rcpt_plan_dt}, rmrk_desc=#{state.rmrk_desc},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND bill_stts_cd='DRAFT'
UPDATE bill.bill_dtl SET ovtm_amt=#{line.ovtm_amt},bill_amt=#{line.bill_amt} WHERE bill_id=#{billId} AND asgn_id=#{line.asgn_id}
